property_taxes_annual.source: Ecuador property tax regulations and comparable properties
property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador municipal property tax (impuesto predial) ranges 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value per PWC Ecuador tax summary. Comparable Manta condos: Oceania loft ($194K) pays $136/yr; Las Olas 2BR ($279K) under $400/yr; Ibiza duplex under $400/yr. For $62,150 property at mid-range 0.28%: ~$175/yr. Range estimate $100-250/yr.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is mandatory and included in HOA fees in Ecuador. Owner supplemental insurance (contents + building replacement) recommended. EcuadorInsurance.org: $75K condo costs $225-600/yr. Manta carries 15-20% premium over inland due to earthquake risk. For $62K condo in Manta: estimate $250-400/yr. Using $300/yr mid-point. This is optional but prudent coverage beyond HOA-included building policy.

management_annual.evidence: Ecuador property management fees for ongoing services (rent collection, maintenance coordination, tenant liaison) typically range 8-15% of monthly rent per Expat Focus. At $500/mo rent: 8% = $480/yr, 15% = $900/yr. Mid-point 10% = $600/yr used. Self-management would reduce this to $0 but requires local presence.

utilities_annual.evidence: In Ecuador long-term rentals, utilities (electricity, water, internet) are typically paid by tenant. Owner-paid utilities would only apply if included in rent. Cannot determine without lease structure. If owner-paid, estimate $50-100/mo ($600-1,200/yr) for 1BR condo based on Ecuador cost of living data.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: No resort fees, club fees, or rental program fees identified in listing. Beach club access appears included with building amenities per listing. No other recurring owner costs found in research. May need to verify with developer if any additional fees apply.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Building bylaws (reglamento interno) not publicly available for Fez Manta. Many Ecuador condo buildings allow rentals but may have restrictions. Pre-sale building may not have finalized bylaws. Must verify rental permission with developer before closing.

str_restrictions.evidence: No national STR ban in Ecuador. SRI (tax authority) requires registration (RUC code I55100904) for Airbnb/Booking hosts, 15% IVA unless registered as tourism operator with LUAF. Building-level STR restrictions may exist in bylaws but Fez Manta bylaws not publicly available. Must verify STR permission with developer. Note: Manta STR market shows avg 21.7% occupancy, $4,104/yr revenue (AirROI 2026) - lower yield than long-term rental.
